Design_Rules.Rule: Each 4x25G SFP28 block runs at one speed (4x1G / 4x10G / 4x25G). A single 25G optic forces the block to 25G and drops 10G/1G optics in that block.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Group uplink optics per 4-port block; never mix 25G and 10G in one block.

Design_Rules.Rule: Stack links run only at the port's highest speed (25G on SFP28, 100G on QSFP28). Up to 8 units, NSF/hitless failover.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Stack cables/optics must be 25G or 100G.

Design_Rules.Rule: Stacking, AVB and PTP TC/BC/GM are mutually exclusive.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: If AVB or PTP (ST 2110/AES67 BC) is required, do not propose a stack; use LAG/MLAG-style design.

Design_Rules.Rule: AVB is not supported on a LAG. Max 256 AVB streams per switch.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: AVB designs need single uplinks or MSTP, not LAG.

Design_Rules.Rule: RPS+EPS work simultaneously: total budget (EPS) and protected budget (internal PSU failed) depend on PSU model, quantity and input voltage.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: When redundancy is required, size PoE to PoE_Budget_Protected_W (worst of internal-PSU or module failure), not the EPS total.

Design_Rules.Rule: Two PSU groups: A (APS350W/600Wv2/920W/2000W) and B (APS600Wv3/1200Wv2/2000Wv2) are model-specific.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Only offer PSUs listed in Compatibility for the chosen model.

Design_Rules.Rule: Output is 1,000W at 110VAC and 2,000W at 220VAC.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Ask for site input voltage before sizing high PoE budgets.

Design_Rules.Rule: PoE budget scales with number of powered internal PSUs (720 / 1,440W; 720 / 1,650 / 2,880W).
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Budget = f(PSUs powered). Redundancy reduces usable budget.

Design_Rules.Rule: PoE+ ports: max 30W/port; Ultra90 PoE++ ports: 15.4/30/60/75/90W classes.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Match endpoint class to port type; 60-90W endpoints need Ultra90 models.

Design_Rules.Rule: 1G SFP / AGM734 supported on ports 1-12 only.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: 1G endpoints/uplinks limited to 12 per switch.

Design_Rules.Rule: 100M support limited: see Port_Notes (e.g. 24X4V ports 1-16 only, 40X4C none, 10G ports on M4X4V none).
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Legacy 100M AV/control devices must land on supported ports.

Design_Rules.Rule: Managed by Insight OR Engage, not both. Exium security license only via Insight.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: If AV design uses Engage, no Exium license line.

Design_Rules.Rule: 32 VLANs / 32 DHCP servers max; 2,000 clients.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Flag designs with >32 VLANs/AV profiles.

Design_Rules.Rule: PD draw 25W; 802.3at required for full performance (802.3af reduces throughput, disables 6GHz). 2.5G uplink.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Needs PoE+ port; 2.5G port recommended.

Design_Rules.Rule: PD draw 39W; 802.3bt for full performance (802.3at reduces throughput; 802.3af unsupported). 10G uplink.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Needs Ultra90/PoE++ port; 10G multi-gig port recommended (e.g. M4350-36X4V / 40X4C / 24X8F8V).

Design_Rules.Rule: Ships with 1x APS254W (119W). 2 more adapters: 322W (2 total) / 551W (3 total); redundant 119W (1+1) or 322W (2+1).
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Add APS254W qty per PoE need; optional PST4310 tray.

Design_Rules.Rule: Operating max: 45C PoE models, 50C non-PoE (M4250 12M2XF/16XF, M4350 non-PoE).
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Check rack ambient for closet/IDF installs.

Design_Rules.Rule: SFP28 port speed is set per 4-port block (1G / 10G / 25G); ports ship at 10G.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Group 1G, 10G and 25G optics in separate 4-port blocks.

Design_Rules.Rule: DAC and AOC cables are not compatible with the PR460X SFP+ port.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Gateway to core uses a 10G SR optic on both ends and an LC patch cord.

Design_Rules.Rule: One interface card slot: APM414V (4x SFP28, installed), APM414C (4x 10GBASE-T), APM414SD/LD (opticalCON QUAD, MMF/SMF). One card at a time.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: Uplink media follows the card; opticalCON cards need SFP28/SFP+ transceivers in the internal cages and Neutrik opticalCON field cables.

Design_Rules.Rule: In a LAG only one physical link carries AVB payload; the other links are backup.
Design_Rules.BoM_Impact: AVB bandwidth through a LAG is one link, not the LAG total.

Endpoints.Name: 1G AV-over-IP encoder (TX)
Endpoints.Notes: e.g. 1G HDMI/USB encoder; set PoE to maker spec

Endpoints.Name: 10G AV-over-IP encoder (copper)
Endpoints.Notes: SDVoE / uncompressed class; usually locally powered

Endpoints.Name: 25G ST 2110 device (SFP28)
Endpoints.Notes: 25G SR optic added to BoM. ST 2110 timing (SMPTE 2059-2) needs a PTP boundary clock

Endpoints.Name: AVB / Milan audio device
Endpoints.Notes: Needs AVB-capable switches; M4250 AVB does not run over a LAG

Endpoints.Name: ST 2110-30 / AES67 audio device
Endpoints.Notes: PTP (SMPTE 2059-2 / AES67) via boundary clock switches. Clear Timing if your design uses transparent clock only
